name: bokeh_bloom
description: a glowing bloom with bokeh: soft lit petals with bright rims and fine veining, the set's lace as dark veins, a hot heart, soft out-of-focus discs and sparkle dust in the dark around it, rust to gold

reference.made_with: a fractal render (flower, depth of field)

notes: Round one (093): triage group (14), shells and blooms. wallhaven-8xz1mk (a glowing flower with bokeh) is the default; no entry.

Nearest mode: dew_bloom (soft lit petals ringed by pink rims, the lace inked dark, dew sparkles). What differs: depth of field. The far field is multiplied towards the map's dark end on the distance estimate, and over it lie bokeh: a faded circle packing (the bubble trap at radius 0.3, spacing 1, largest 0.4, smallest 1/8 of that, fade 0.5) drawn as soft flat discs added in the map's orange, masked to the far field. A brighter rim (the inverted height) was dropped: inverted, a faded height reads 1 where it faded and lit hard-edged shards. The petals carry fine veining (stripe grain at density 48, multiplied) and a warm radial heart.
Reachable by one escape loop: no. Petals, veins and grain are the frame's loop; the bokeh is a bubble trap's loop (two loops a sample).

Lessons: unmasked and unbounded, the bubble packs the whole frame in discs (a foam, not bokeh); `largest` leaves the far field to the big early discs, and the fade lets them come and go. Screened at 0.35 over lit petals the discs vanish under the tone pass: they need `add`, the far field darkened first, and opacity about 0.85. A radial heart above about 0.3 reads as fog over the frame's middle; discs under `largest` 0.4 are too small to read as bokeh at draft size.
Seats: a gallery scout (seed 931, no ink filter), ten kept by eye where a spiral bloom has room. The bokeh is plain at shallow seats with far field and faint where the lace fills the frame.
Tone: 12 of 12 hold the reference's balance (median 0.148 to 0.157 against 0.147).

Explorer cost (093, `style cost --location`, beside another item's work: an upper bound): 38.5 s as WebAssembly on one thread at 1280x800 ss2 at the deeper formulation seat (phoenix_625d9378, maxiter 3,000), under the 5-minute bar.
